data.name: Dacia
data.gender_notes: Dacia is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Roman mythology, Dacia was a goddess associated with fertility and agriculture. The name Dacia comes from the Latin word 'Dacia' meaning 'the land'. This name was given to the province of Romania, and later to its people. In Christianity, Dacia represents the fertile land of spiritual growth. The name Dacia carries the meaning “Daughter of the land” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Dacia usually hope their child will grow to embody daughter of the land and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Dacia belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Daughter of the land.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Dacia total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_hebrew.name: דאקיה
in_hebrew.meaning: מקור רומאי, שם מדינה יוונית, זיהוי גאוגרפי
in_hebrew.long_meaning: דאקיה (Dacia) היא שם שהיה נהוג בעת העתיקה. מקור השם רומאי, ובעברית חדשה, השם קשור לגאוגרפיה. בדברי יוסף, Dacia היא פרובינציה רומאית, ששכנה באזור של יוון העתיקה. בעקבות הנוצריות, Dacia הפכה לסמל כבוד. כיום, Dacia היא שם נפוץ לבנות. השם Dacia מקושר לערכי זהות, עצמאות, וקשר שפלילי.

in_greek.name: Δακία
in_greek.long_meaning: Η Δακία (Δακία) είναι ονομασία που χρησιμοποιήθηκε κατά την αρχαιότητα. Η προέλευση της ονομασίας είναι Ρωμαική. Σε νεοελληνική γλώσσα, η ονομασία σχετίζεται με τη γεωγραφία. Κατά τις πηγές του Ιωσήφ, η Δακία είναι Ρωμαική επαρχία, η οποία ευρίσκεται στην περιοχή της αρχαίας Ελλάδας. Με την έλευση του Χριστιανισμού, η Δακία έγινε σύμβολο τιμής. Σήμερα, η ονομασία Δακία είναι δημοφιλές για κορίτσια. Η ονομασία Δακία σχετίζεται με τους θεσμούς της ταυτότητας, της ανεξαρτησίας και της φιλίας.

in_latin.name: Dacia
in_latin.long_meaning: Dacia est nomen quod fuit usitatum in antiquitate. Originem habet a Romanis. In lingua Latina nova, nomen est coniunctum cum geographia. Ex Iosephus scriptis, Dacia fuit provincia Romana, quae erat in loco Graecorum antiquorum. Cum adventu Christianismi, Dacia facta est symbolum honoris. Hodie, nomen Dacia est popularis nomen feminarum. Nomen Dacia coniunctum est cum rationibus identitatis, libertatis, et amicitiae.

in_english.name: Dacia
in_english.long_meaning: Dacia is a name that was used in antiquity. Its origin is Roman. In modern English, the name is connected to geography. According to Josephus, Dacia was a Roman province, located in the area of ancient Greece. With the advent of Christianity, Dacia became a symbol of honor. Today, the name Dacia is a popular name for girls. The name Dacia is connected to values of identity, independence, and friendship.

data.cultural_impact: The name Dacia has been historically significant in the Roman Empire, as it was the name of a province located in present-day Romania. It has also been used to describe the Roman people who lived in that region. The name continues to be used today, particularly in the Romanian Orthodox Church, and is a source of pride and identity for many Romanians.
data.spiritual_significance: In the Christian context, Dacia represents the fertile land of spiritual growth. It is a reminder that just as the soil in Romania has the potential to produce rich harvests, so too do we as individuals have the potential to grow spiritually and bear fruit. The name Dacia encourages us to cultivate our own spiritual gardens, tending to them with care and attention, and trusting that through God's grace, we will bear fruit in due season.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Dacia symbolizes strength and endurance in the face of adversity. Named after the ancient Roman province, it serves as a reminder of the resilience of the early Christian community in the face of Roman persecution. Embracing the challenges of life with faith and courage, the name Dacia embodies the unwavering spirit that shines forth in the hearts of those who bear it.
